name: Porridge with blueberries
steps: Simmer oats and milk together for 4-5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with blueberries.
Drizzle with honey to serve.

name: Scrambled eggs on wholemeal toast
steps: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat and add the eggs, stirring gently until just set.
Toast the bread and serve the eggs on top with halved cherry tomatoes on the side.

name: Greek yogurt with granola and fruit
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Slice the banana and scatter over with the granola.

name: Overnight oats with berries
steps: The night before, stir oats, milk and yogurt together in a jar or container.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with mixed berries in the morning before serving.

name: Wholemeal pancakes with banana
steps: Whisk flour, egg and milk together into a smooth batter.
Pour small rounds into a lightly greased hot pan and cook 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve topped with sliced banana.

name: Avocado and poached egg on toast
steps: Toast the bread and mash the avocado on top with a little salt and pepper.
Simmer water in a pan, swirl, and crack in the egg; poach 3 minutes until white is set.
Lift out with a slotted spoon and place on the avocado toast.

name: Fruit and seed muesli with milk
steps: Pour muesli into a bowl and add the milk.
Grate or dice the apple and stir through before serving.

name: French toast with berries
steps: Whisk egg and milk together in a shallow dish.
Dip the bread in the mixture, coating both sides.
Fry in a lightly greased pan for 2 minutes per side until golden, then top with berries.
